epilogue.title: From a history of the Silesian wars (1790)
epilogue.text: Khevenhüller served the young Queen for a few weeks in the autumn of 1740 and then withdrew. Historians have judged his caution kindly.
epilogue.verdict: A careful servant who saw the danger early and could not make the court believe it.
